_note: Retrieval eval set. Queries are paraphrases (need semantic matching, not keyword overlap) so the harness discriminates a real embedder/reranker/HyDE from the stub. Distractors (ble/rtos/ip67) must NOT surface.

items.content: Chose a low-side shunt resistor with a delta-sigma ADC for main pack current sensing
Continuous 100A with 200A surges for five seconds
Sensing bill of materials under three dollars at ten thousand units per year
Sealed enclosure reaching sixty degrees C ambient, no forced air
State-of-charge estimate must stay within two percent
Isolation to 500 Vrms between the pack and the low-voltage side
Uses an Amphenol Surlok connector rated for 250A continuous
A phone app over Bluetooth shows the charge level to the end user
Control firmware uses FreeRTOS with a one kilohertz control loop
The housing is IP67 rated blue ABS plastic

queries.query: how should I measure the battery pack current accurately and cheaply
what accuracy do I need for the fuel gauge
the thermal environment the board has to survive
safety separation between the high and low voltage domains
which connector can handle the high current
